# ADR-3073: A07: Password minimum length setting for realm 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Short passwords fall to online guessing.

## Decision

Identity configuration MUST declare a password minimum length setting for realm 1 (A07-1).

## Consequences

Compromised-password checks complement length.
